ComponentDescription: Audio recorder with inference notification support

com.trust.recorder:mqttproxy:1.policyDescription: Subscribe to recording commands and publish ack

com.trust.recorder:pubsub:1.policyDescription: Publish recording ready notification to local IPC

Install.Script:
set -e
python3 -m venv '{work:path}/venv' || true
PY='{work:path}/venv/bin/python'
PIP='{work:path}/venv/bin/pip'
if [ ! -x "$PY" ]; then PY=python3; PIP=pip; fi
$PY -m pip install --upgrade pip
$PIP install boto3 awsiotsdk

Run.Script: PY='{work:path}/venv/bin/python'; if [ ! -x "$PY" ]; then PY=python3; fi; exec "$PY" -u {artifacts:path}/recorder.py
